note: Past episodes used to measure the wave after a shock. Start dates are quoted from the listed source. The baseline for every episode is the close of the last trading day before the start date. Windows and rules are fixed for all episodes.

oil_rule.text: A rule-based oil episode starts on the first day Brent closes at least 20% above its close 20 trading days earlier and at its highest close in 252 trading days. No new episode can start for 126 trading days.

current_note: Rule-based oil episodes that start on or after this date belong to the open card 2026-us-iran-war-oil. They are shown as the present and left out of the past range.
